data.name: Lovkush
data.gender_notes: Lovkush is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Lovkush is the name of a king who brought happiness and prosperity to his people. Derived from Sanskrit words 'Lov' (happiness) and 'Kush' (prosperity). The name Lovkush carries the meaning “Bringer of happiness and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lovkush usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of happiness and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: May this name bring happiness and prosperity to the bearer throughout his life.
data.etymology: Lovkush belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of happiness and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lovkush total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Lovkush was a legendary king of ancient India, mentioned in various Hindu texts. He is described as a powerful monarch who ruled over the kingdom of Kushasthali in the Himalayan region, around the 10th century BCE.

Another mention of Lovkush is found in the epic Mahabharata, where he is described as the grandson of the divine king Sahasrarjuna and the father of King Sahyadhri. Lovkush is known for his religious devotion and his exploits against various demonic forces.
